paragraphs: The G500 4x4² is a special-edition version of the pre-2018 W463 G-Class, fitted with the M157 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8 — the same engine used in the contemporary G63 AMG. It was a limited-production model, designed as an even more capable off-road variant with portal axles and a significantly increased ride height. The M157 engine is shared with other performance Mercedes models of that era, known for its strong power delivery and, like other AMG-sourced V8s, a pattern of valve seal and coolant system wear over time. The G500 4x4² is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every G500 4X4² on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the G500 4X4² from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the G500 4x4² is a special-edition model, ensuring the correct engine and component compatibility is crucial. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (M157) via registration or VIN - The specific specifications of the G500 4x4² package - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
